description: Contact says they are the wrong person and names a colleague with an email. Expected: the colleague becomes a new contact and/or a research task (not a cold email straight to them); note on the original contact.

sent.subject: Overselling across your Shopee and Lazada shops
sent.body:
Hi Quang,

GreenLeaf sells on Shopee and Lazada. How do you keep stock counts consistent between the two when you're fulfilling orders?

StockSync syncs them automatically within about a minute. Open to a 20-minute call?

Mai, StockSync
(Reply UNSUBSCRIBE and we'll stop.)

inbound.body: Hi Mai, I only handle the warehouse so I'm not the right person for this. Our e-commerce manager Hoa Tran runs the Shopee and Lazada shops and decides on tools like this: hoa.tran@greenleaf-eval.example. Please talk to her instead.
